about: A person's recorded pronoun set as the words a third-person sentence fills: subject at a sentence's start, subject inside one, object, reflexive and possessive. A set with no row here (they-them) is said with the they form of a line. Read by src/english/pronoun-words.ts. byGender is the pronoun set a person who has only a recorded gender is said with (an official the officials engine seats by identity); any other gender is said with the they form.
